Este é o Hall da Fama. Hoje o Marco ganh.en: This is the Hall of Fame. Today the Marker gets a new name: {JOGADOR}, Champion of Costa do Sol! And beside your name go theirs — because nobody climbs this Platô alone.

Os Guardiões do Hall cuidaram da sua equ.en: The Hall's Guardians took care of your team: all of them up and rested.

O título abre o que estava fechado. A li.en: The title opens what was closed. The mountain line and the great river are too dangerous for anyone who hasn't proven what you proved today.

O Passe vale no Trem Serra-Sol, em Porto.en: The Pass is good on the Serra-Sol Train, in Porto Sereia. The Ticket, on the Saveiro from Cidade Coral. Both lead to the Sertão das Névoas, where there are eight more badges — and people worse than power-plant goons. And every Champion takes a stone from our collection home from the Platô. Pick yours.

O Passe é do Trem Serra-Sol, em Porto Se.en: The Pass is for the Serra-Sol Train, in Porto Sereia. The Ticket, for the Saveiro from Cidade Coral. Both lead to the Sertão das Névoas, where there are eight more badges — and people worse than power-plant goons. Just don't rush to the station: the mountain line and the Saveiro are under repair. Keep both; they're good as soon as they reopen. And every Champion takes a stone from our collection home from the Platô. Pick yours.

Qual Pedra de Evolução você quer?.en: Which Evolution Stone do you want?

\"Interrompemos a moda de viola para uma.en: "We interrupt this fiddle tune for news from the Platô: Costa do Sol has a new Champion! {JOGADOR}, from Vila Jacarandá, has won the League of Guardians! With that, the Sertão das Névoas region is now open: the Serra-Sol Train and the Saveiro are taking the Champion aboard again. Safe travels, and bring a coat!"

"We interrupt this fiddle tune for news from the Platô: Costa do Sol has a new Champion! {JOGADOR}, from Vila Jacarandá, has won the League of Guardians! The trip to the Sertão das Névoas will have to wait a little: the Serra-Sol Train and the Saveiro are still under repair, and this station will let you know when they reopen. Until then, all of Costa do Sol wants to meet the Champion!"

Ouviu? Agora é oficial. Vá ver o sol nas.en: Hear that? Now it's official. Go watch the sun rise on the other side of the mountains, Champion. The Platô stays with me a little longer.

Ouviu? Agora é oficial. Enquanto a serra.en: Hear that? Now it's official. Until the mountains open, walk the Coast with the title on your chest: there are creatures you haven't seen yet and people who'll want a rematch. The Platô stays with me a little longer.

GANHEI DO CAMPEÃO! Ouviu, Platô?! …Tá, v.en: I BEAT THE CHAMPION! Hear that, Platô?! …Fine, you were tired from five battles. I know. But I won.

Sabe o que eu descobri, {JOGADOR}? Que e.en: You know what I figured out, {JOGADOR}? I spent eight badges wanting to beat you, and you spent eight badges taking care of your creatures. I'm going back in there to beat that League my own way. And then, when the mountain line reopens, I'm taking the train. The Rust Cartel ran off to the sertão, and I still have a score to settle with people who cage creatures.

Te vejo do outro lado da serra, Campeão..en: See you on the other side of the mountains, Champion. And don't get used to the title: I told you I'm next.

Como vai a criatura que eu te confiei? E.en: How's the creature I entrusted to you? She used to sit by the window every day, watching the road. I think she was waiting for you. When you cross the mountains, send news: all I know of the Sertão das Névoas is what the drovers tell.

{JOGADOR}! A Ipê falou tanto de você nas.en: {JOGADOR}! Ipê talked about you so much in her letters I already knew you by heart. And now with the Leaf Badge in your case! Ever since that day in her lab, I've had one of the creatures that stayed on the table. Ipê asked me to give it only to someone who took good care of the first one.

Ela ainda é pequena, mas aprende depress.en: She's still small, but she learns fast next to a team like yours. They say the third creature from that table was born again from an egg on Praia das Tartarugas. But that's a matter for the tide, not the vereda.

Bem-vindo ao laboratório de campo! Eu so.en: Welcome to the field lab! I'm Dr. Buriti: I study veredas, marshes and everything that sings at night. I'm keeping a creature for a trainer I can trust. Come back with the Leaf Badge, from this village's gym, and we'll talk.

Leve ao Seu Jatobá, o dono do Parque Saf.en: Take it to Seu Jatobá, the owner of the Safari Park, up in Vale do Buriti-Alto. The cart track from the League Platô goes up there.

Ô, Campeão! Parabéns pela Liga! Eu sou o.en: Hey, Champion! Congrats on the League! I'm Tião, from the ox cart.

Lá em cima, na trilha do leste, fica o V.en: Up there, on the east trail, is Vale do Buriti-Alto: it has the Creature Games and Seu Jatobá's Safari Park. Only Champions go up, the trail's a rough one.

Subir de carro de boi para o Vale do Bur.en: Ride the ox cart up to Vale do Buriti-Alto?

Chegamos! Quando quiser descer, é só fal.en: We're here! When you want to go down, just talk to me here at the entrance.

O boi espera. Ele é paciente; eu também..en: The ox will wait. He's patient; so am I.

Descer para o Platô da Liga?.en: Go down to the League Platô?

Aproveite o vale. Dizem que a Juíza Bia.en: Enjoy the valley. They say Judge Bia runs faster than the creatures.

Ponto de prova vale prêmio! Vitamina de.en: Games points win prizes! Fruit shakes, evolution stones, scrolls and brown sugar. No betting: here you only win by running.

Criatura cansada de prova não rende. Dei.en: A creature worn out from the trials won't perform. Let me bless them with rue and buriti water.

Pronto: todo mundo inteirinho. Vai com f.en: There: everyone's good as new. Go with faith and with breath.

Bem-vindo ao Parque Safári do Buriti-Alt.en: Welcome to the Buriti-Alto Safari Park! No battling here: creatures are wild and stay wild until you form a partnership.

Lá dentro você tem ISCA (ela come e foge.en: Inside you have BAIT (it eats and flees less, but the gourd works worse), ROCK (it gets angry: the gourd works better, but it flees more) and CLOSER (creeping up slowly helps the gourd).

Entrada: 500 patacas, 30 Cuias-Safári e.en: Entry: 500 patacas, 30 Safari Gourds and 500 steps. Going in?

As criaturas só aparecem no capim alto d.en: Creatures only show up in the park's tall grass. Each sector has its own critters, by day and by night.

Os passos acabam? O passeio acaba. As cu.en: Out of steps? The outing's over. Out of gourds? Same. Walked out the gate? That too. Any Safari Gourds left over stay here with me.

O parque só tem a Vereda por enquanto. O.en: For now the park only has the Vereda. Seu Jatobá builds the other sectors with what folks bring: river stones, buriti saplings, hollow logs… Talk to him over at the house.

Aqui estão as 30 Cuias-Safári. Boa caçad.en: Here are your 30 Safari Gourds. Happy hunting… I mean, happy partnering! Tweeet, gate's open!

Faltam patacas, criatura. A entrada é 50.en: Not enough patacas, buddy. Entry is 500, and the park needs grass and food for the critters.

Tá certo. A porteira fica aqui esperando.en: All right. The gate will be right here waiting.

Sou guia do parque. Dica de quem anda no.en: I'm a park guide. Tip from someone who walks the grass: the Rock makes a critter angry and easier to catch, but it flees more. Use it when you have gourds to spare.

E o Seu Jatobá quer material para os set.en: And Seu Jatobá wants materials for the new sectors: river stones, which a fisher on Trilha dos Cipós collects by the river; buriti saplings, from the nursery keeper in Vila Buriti; and hollow logs, from the woodcutter on Estrada do Buriti.

Ô, Campeão! Sabe o que este rio faz? Rol.en: Hey, Champion! Know what this river does? It rolls stones. Rolls them so much they come out smooth and round, perfect for lining a bank.

O Seu Jatobá do Safári anda pedindo pedr.en: Seu Jatobá from the Safari has been asking for river stones for his new lagoon. Here, the prettiest one I found.

Essa pedra que te dei veio de três cacho.en: That stone I gave you came from three waterfalls upstream. It took longer than I did to get here.

Buriti é a árvore da água: onde ele nasc.en: Buriti is the water tree: where it sprouts, the marsh comes along, and the critters follow.

Esta muda é das boas. Planta na beira de.en: This sapling is a good one. Plant it by running water and talk to it now and then.

A muda pegou? Buriti demora, mas quando.en: Did the sapling take? Buriti is slow, but once it's rooted no drought can knock it down.

Eu só corto árvore que já caiu, viu? E e.en: I only cut trees that have already fallen, you know? And this one fell hollow: an owl used to live inside.

Tronco oco é casa pronta. O Seu Jatobá f.en: A hollow log is a ready-made home. Seu Jatobá said he wants to make a den for the night critters at the Safari. Take it, it's light.

Tronco oco é casa de coruja, de urutau,.en: A hollow log is home to owls, potoos, possums… Night critters like dark and quiet.

Campeã da Costa, campeã da Costa… aqui n.en: Coast Champion, Coast Champion… out here in the Sertão critters are born big! Let's see you hold on!

Aguentou. E ainda sorriu..en: You held on. And you even smiled.

Os selvagens daqui são do tamanho da Lig.en: The wild ones here are League-sized. Stop by the Vila Cascavel Post whenever you can.

Lagoa do Chapéu Perdido, peixe achado! V.en: Lost Hat Lagoon, found fish! Let's see if you take the bait.

Quem mordeu fui eu..en: Turns out I'm the one who got hooked.

Vara Boa aqui pega Dourado-Rei. Vara Vel.en: A Good Rod catches Dourado-Rei here. An Old Rod only catches Piabinha, but Piabinhas are people too.

O buritizal é casa de Antão e de abelha-.en: The buriti grove is home to Antão and queen bees. Tread softly… or fight fast!

O buritizal aplaude. Eu não..en: The buriti grove applauds. I don't.

Atrás do cipó tem um bosque escondido. O.en: Behind the vines there's a hidden grove. The Machete opens it, but close the door on your way out. Kidding: there's no door.

No cercado do Seu Nico quem manda sou eu.en: In Seu Nico's corral, the boss is me and my seriema. Yee-haw!

Para voltar mais rápido, pule as saliênc.en: To get back faster, hop down the corral ledges. To go forward, follow the gates.

Psiu! Uma Araracanga pousou no buriti. A.en: Shh! An Araracanga landed on the buriti. Now it's going to land on you!

Voou. Eu também queria voar daqui..en: It flew off. I wish I could fly off too.

A observadora do Cerrado Aberto está pro.en: The birdwatcher in Cerrado Aberto is looking for nests to photograph. Go talk to her, she loves a chat.

Roda de capoeira na beira da vereda! Ent.en: Capoeira roda by the vereda! Jump in, the berimbau won't wait!

Lá em Cidade Ginga tem um mestre de verd.en: In Cidade Ginga there's a real master. But first you've got a lot of chapada to climb.

Lição de escoteira número um: nunca sube.en: Scout lesson number one: never underestimate an Emaçu. Lesson number two: never underestimate me!

Lição número três: perder também ensina..en: Lesson number three: losing teaches too.

A estrada dá a volta no capinzal. Se voc.en: The road loops around the tall grass. If you get lost, follow the tallest termite mound. Or the shortest.

Ô treinador! No cerrado quem chocalha pr.en: Hey, trainer! In the cerrado, whoever rattles first wins. Did you hear my Cascavelão?

Chocalhou foi o meu joelho..en: The only thing rattling now is my knees.

A saída leste do cerrado desce para o Pa.en: The cerrado's east exit goes down to the Pantanal. From there, take the boardwalks to Pantanal Grande.

O Gaviãozão vê um rato a dois quilômetro.en: Gaviãozão can spot a rat two kilometers away. I can spot a challenger two meters away!

Vi tudo. Inclusive a minha derrota..en: I saw everything. Including my own defeat.

Os ninhos do cerrado ficam no alto dos i.en: Cerrado nests sit high up in the ipê trees. The birdwatcher photographs them but never touches. Do the same.

No cerrado aberto a roda é grande! Vem,.en: In the open cerrado the roda is huge! Come on, the rhea's already in!

Saí da roda pela porta dos fundos..en: I left the roda through the back door.

Treine Ginga contra Ginga e você aprende.en: Train Brawl against Brawl and you learn where it hurts. I just learned.

Pesquisa de campo: quanto tempo um Campe.en: Field research: how long can a League Champion last against a Cupinzeiro-Vivo? Starting the stopwatch!

Resultado: pouco. O meu cupinzeiro, quer.en: Result: not long. My termite mound, I mean.

O Quebra-pedra abre as rochas rachadas e.en: Rock Smash opens cracked rocks and old termite mounds. Inside are critters that have never seen the sun.

Ô menino da Costa, que veio de trem, / n.en: Hey, kid from the Coast, who came by the train, / no one crosses the cerrado, it's all in vain! / Only those who can sing and can battle remain!

Perdi a rima, perdi a batalha, / sobrou.en: Lost my rhyme, lost the fight, what a mess, / all I've got is my fiddle and a straw hat, I guess.

De noite o cerrado brilha de Vagalampo..en: At night the cerrado glows with Vagalampo. Whoever walks in the dark walks with music.

O Tuiuiú é a ave símbolo do Pantanal. E.en: The Tuiuiú is the Pantanal's symbol bird. And this battle is the symbol of my stubbornness!

O Tuiuiú voou para longe. Eu fiquei..en: The Tuiuiú flew far away. I stayed.

Ali na passarela tem um ninho no Morro d.en: Over by the boardwalk there's a nest on Morro do Urucum the birdwatcher will want in her photo.

Pesquei um Jaú-Gigante do tamanho da can.en: I caught a Jaú-Gigante as big as my canoe! Now I'm going to catch a win!

O peixe grande escapou. Como sempre..en: The big one got away. As always.

Na água funda do sul, com Vara Mestra, d.en: In the deep water to the south, with a Master Rod, they say Pirarucão bites. Never seen it. But I believe it.

Tocando boiada pelo alagado desde menino.en: I've been driving cattle through the floodplain since I was a boy. You're just one more steer in the way!

Pantanal Grande é logo ali, depois das p.en: Pantanal Grande is just past the stilt houses. Zefa never loses to anyone… almost.

Sou peão da Boiadeira Zefa! Antes de ent.en: I'm Cowgirl Zefa's ranch hand! Before you enter her gym, you go through me!

Passou. A Zefa vai gostar de você..en: You got through. Zefa's going to like you.

No ginásio o chão é de lama que afunda..en: In the gym the floor is sinking mud. Plan your path before taking the first step.

Aguapé flutua, Lavadeira-Dragão voa e vo.en: Water hyacinths float, Lavadeira-Dragão flies and you… you're going down!

Caí eu, na lagoa, de roupa e tudo..en: I went down, into the lagoon, clothes and all.

Leve criatura de Rio, Mata ou Geada para.en: Bring River, Grass or Frost creatures to Zefa. Earth critters sink in the water.

Ninhal fechado para reforma! Reforma do.en: Rookery closed for renovations! Rust Cartel renovations, of course.

Reformaram foi a minha cara..en: The only thing renovated was my face.

O tenente Arame está lá no meio, contand.en: Lieutenant Arame is in the middle, counting eggs. He miscounts on purpose so there are extras for him.

Ovo de tuiuiú vale ouro lá fora. E você.en: Tuiuiú eggs are worth gold abroad. And you're worth a kick in the pants!

Quem levou o pé fui eu..en: I'm the one who got kicked.

Os ovos estão no barco, prontos para des.en: The eggs are on the boat, ready to go downriver. If Arame falls, they go back to the nests.

Mais um passo e eu chamo o tenente! Aliá.en: One more step and I'm calling the lieutenant! Actually, he's already coming.

Pode ir. Eu não vi nada..en: Go on. I didn't see anything.

Ilhota do sudeste: meu pesqueiro secreto.en: The southeast islet: my secret fishing spot. If you found it, you'll have to fight!

Pode pescar aqui. Mas não conte para nin.en: You can fish here. Just don't tell anyone.

O Ariranhão anda em bando. Se aparecer u.en: Ariranhão travel in packs. If one shows up, four more are already watching.

Tenente Arame, do Cartel Ferrugem, às or.en: Lieutenant Arame, Rust Cartel, at Colonel Garrote's command. This rookery is our pen now, fenced in barbed wire! League Champion, huh? On the Coast you crushed Lata and bent Rebite. No such luck with me: wire bends, but it doesn't break!

Vergou… e quebrou. Arame velho é assim..en: It bent… and it broke. That's old wire for you.

No cais quem não pesca, luta. E eu faço.en: On the docks, whoever isn't fishing is fighting. And I do both!

Hoje não deu peixe nem vitória..en: No fish and no win today.

O Saveiro desce o rio até Cidade Coral..en: The Saveiro goes downriver to Cidade Coral. If you get seasick going, you get less seasick coming back.

Já surfei a pororoca! Uma batalhinha no.en: I've surfed the pororoca! A little battle on the docks is a ripple to me!

A Estrada Vermelha sobe para a Chapada R.en: The Estrada Vermelha climbs up to Chapada Rubra. Up there the only wave is a heat wave.

Tropa de mula parada na estrada? Não: tr.en: A mule train stuck on the road? No: a creature train ready for a brawl!

A tropa voltou para o pasto..en: The train went back to pasture.

Tem três rochas rachadas fechando a estr.en: Three cracked rocks are blocking the road. Rock Smash opens them and the path goes on.

Bateei a estrada inteira atrás de pepita.en: I panned the whole road looking for nuggets. Found you. You'll do!

Pepita sai de rocha rachada. O Seu Casca.en: Nuggets come from cracked rocks. Seu Cascalho, in Chapada Rubra, trades nuggets for scrolls.

Urubu-Rei voa em círculo em cima de quem.en: The Urubu-Rei circles above whoever's about to lose. Look up!

Ele estava em cima de mim o tempo todo..en: It was above me the whole time.

Na Mesa do Gavião tem um ninho que nenhu.en: On Mesa do Gavião there's a nest no camera can reach. Only climbers.

Na Estrada Vermelha, de terra e de sol,.en: On the Estrada Vermelha, all dust and all sun, / I sing and I battle, it's twice the fun! / Whoever loses gets my lighthouse, hon!

Ganhou o duelo, levou o farol… / brincad.en: You won the duel, took the light as your own… / kidding, the light belongs to the sun alone.

Viola e criatura: as duas pedem afinação.en: Fiddle and creature: both need tuning. And patience.

Treino para os paredões da chapada! Você.en: Training for the chapada cliffs! You're my warm-up!

Aqueceu demais. Queimei..en: Warmed up too much. I got burned.

Sem o Amuleto de Escalar ninguém sobe o.en: Without the Climb Charm no one gets up the Chapada Rubra cliff. Topázio is the one who gives it out.

Meu bicho dá o bote antes do berimbau te.en: My critter strikes before the berimbau finishes the song. Dodge!

Jararacuçu não avisa. Cascavelão avisa,.en: A Jararacuçu gives no warning. A Cascavelão does, but by then it's too late.

Última curva antes da Chapada Rubra! Daq.en: Last bend before Chapada Rubra! From here on, only the thick-shelled get through!

Casco duro e cabeça mole, o meu..en: Thick shell and soft head, that's me.

Dizem que o Cartel tomou a Mina Velha. O.en: They say the Cartel took over the Mina Velha. Topázio went down alone to get them out.

Ginásio fechado, mas eu estou aberto! Pa.en: The gym's closed, but I'm open! For battles, I mean.

O ginásio só abre quando o Topázio volta.en: The gym only opens when Topázio comes back from the mine. The mine entrance is to the east, past the bonfire.

Daqui eu vejo o paredão inteiro. Daqui e.en: From here I can see the whole cliff. And from here I can also see your defeat!

Bicho de Pedra apanha de Rio, Mata, Ging.en: Stone critters get beaten by River, Grass, Brawl, Earth and Iron. Build your team with that in mind.

Mina interditada pelo Cartel Ferrugem! V.en: Mine closed by the Rust Cartel! Back to the surface!

Volto eu..en: I'll be the one going back.

As gaiolas estão lá embaixo. A escada fi.en: The cages are down below. The ladder is in the northeast corner. Oops.

Galeria de cima é minha! A de baixo é do.en: The upper gallery is mine! The lower one is the lieutenant's!

A de cima também não é mais minha..en: The upper one isn't mine anymore either.

O tenente Rebite voltou da Costa jurando.en: Lieutenant Rebite came back from the Coast swearing revenge. He hates Champions. And ladders.

O Cartel me prendeu aqui para cavar túne.en: The Cartel locked me in here to dig tunnels. At least an honest battle, for a change!

Lá embaixo o Topázio está amarrado, mas.en: Down below, Topázio is tied up, but he won't stop giving advice. Stubborn as they come.

Ninguém passa da galeria funda! Ordens d.en: Nobody gets past the deep gallery! Lieutenant Rebite's orders!

Esses bichos todos vão para fora do país.en: All these critters are going out of the country. You're going out of the mine!

Saio eu. De ré..en: I'm the one going out. Backwards.

Na planilha do tenente tem até o nome do.en: The lieutenant's spreadsheet even has the buyer's name. He's disorganized.

Último capanga antes do tenente! Último.en: Last goon before the lieutenant! Last obstacle! Last…

VOCÊ! O moleque do Farol! Perdi a lanter.en: YOU! The kid from the Lighthouse! I lost the lantern, lost the lighthouse, lost my fake lightkeeper job… But down here, in my mine, I'll bolt you to the rock! A Rebite never comes loose!

Soltou… Rebite espanado não segura nem q.en: Came loose… A stripped rivet can't even hold up a picture.

Primeiro degrau! Quem não aguenta o prim.en: First step! If you can't handle the first step, you won't climb the fifth!

Desci um degrau na vida..en: I went down a step in life.

Cada paredão tem um pé de trepadeira. A.en: Every cliff has creepers at the bottom. The ledge at the edge is for coming down fast.

As Araracangas fazem ninho nos paredões..en: Araracangas nest on the cliffs. And they zap anyone who gets close!

Do alto da chapada dá para ver Arraial B.en: From the top of the chapada you can see Arraial Brasa. The forge smoke rises straight up when there's no wind.

Capoeira em cima de paredão: um passo er.en: Capoeira on a cliff: one wrong step and the roda ends at the bottom!

Terminei lá embaixo. Figurativamente..en: I ended at the bottom. Figuratively.

O Prego-Mestre bate com martelo de pedra.en: Prego-Mestre hits with a stone hammer. Charm and Wind critters take it better.

Ali embaixo tem uma rocha rachada que es.en: Down there a cracked rock hides a cave. But the cave is mine, and you're not getting through!

Passou. A gruta é sua..en: You got through. The cave is yours.

Lá em cima, atrás de um pedregulho, tem.en: Up top, behind a boulder, there's a nook. With Strength you can push it.

Subi a chapada cantando aboio, / desci a.en: I climbed the chapada singing my cattle call, / came down the chapada with no help at all! / Now watch my caravan, it's ready to brawl!

O comboio parou na porteira… / perdi a r.en: The caravan stopped at the gate, what a shame… / lost my rhyme and I lost the whole game.

O Urubu-Rei só aparece quando ninguém es.en: The Urubu-Rei only shows up when no one's looking. Ever thought about that?

Casco de pedra e couraça de ferro: a min.en: Stone shells and iron armor: my team doesn't scratch!

A Caverna Vulcânica é escura de verdade..en: The Caverna Vulcânica is truly dark. Without the Lantern you can't even see your own feet.

Último degrau antes do Arraial! Daqui pa.en: Last step before the Arraial! From here up, only those with cattle-drive stamina get through!

Fôlego de boiada você tem. Eu tenho fôle.en: You've got cattle-drive stamina. I've got calf stamina.

No Arraial Brasa a Ferreira Labareda ace.en: In Arraial Brasa, Smith Labareda lights bonfires in the order of a song. Listen to the accordion.

Pedra de vulcão é a mais bonita: preta e.en: Volcanic rock is the prettiest: black and shiny. Just like my strategy!

O chão esquenta para o norte. No fundo,.en: The ground gets hotter to the north. Deep down, they say, lives whoever heats the ground.

Mergulho em caverna é comigo! Aqui não t.en: Cave diving is my thing! There's no water here, but there's a battle!

O Noitão enxerga no escuro. Eu só enxerg.en: Noitão can see in the dark. I can only see with the Lantern, same as you.

Medindo a caverna há um mês. Agora vou m.en: I've been measuring this cave for a month. Now I'll measure your strength!

Os poços de lava estão cercados de pedra.en: The lava pools are fenced with stone. Thank goodness. I've already lost two boots.

Vim buscar brasa de vulcão para a forja.en: I came for volcano embers for the Arraial Brasa forge. Embers from here never go out!

A Labareda diz que o Boitatá é o padrinh.en: Labareda says Boitatá is the godfather of the Arraial forges. She says it with a straight face.

Aprendiz da Ferreira Labareda! Primeiro.en: Smith Labareda's apprentice! First you get past my hammer!

O martelo entortou. Eu também..en: The hammer got bent. So did I.

A Labareda acende as fogueiras do ginási.en: Labareda lights the gym's bonfires in the order of a song. Listen to the accordion before you go lighting things.

Toca a sanfona, que a quadrilha já vai c.en: Play the accordion, the square dance is on its way! / Whoever joins the circle has to dance and play!

Dançou, ganhou e ainda bateu palma… / a.en: You danced, you won, and you clapped along too… / the square dance is yours, I've lost my cool.

Sábado tem São João no terreiro. A Dona.en: On Saturday there's São João in the yard. Dona Quentão always needs help with the bonfires.

{JOGADOR}! Eu peguei o trem uma semana d.en: {JOGADOR}! I took the train a week after you and I've already beaten Cowgirl Zefa! You've got two Sertão badges and I've got one? Then we're almost tied. Almost isn't tied. Full team, now!

De novo… Mas viu como a minha equipe cre.en: Again… But did you see how my team has grown? I saw yours grow too. The good kind of mad.

Tchê! Campo de altitude é campo de peão..en: Tchê! The high fields are ranch hand country. Here the wind is the minuano and the fight is with the lasso!

Me derrubou do pingo, tchê..en: You knocked me off my horse, tchê.

Quando a geada pega o capim, o Maracajá-.en: When the frost hits the grass, the Maracajá-Nevado comes out to hunt. Only at night, and only the patient get to see it.

A Gralha-Azul planta pinheiro sem querer.en: The Gralha-Azul plants pine trees by accident: it buries the pine nut and forgets. I never forget a challenger!

Agora eu vou esquecer essa luta..en: Now I'm going to forget this fight.

O beija-flor dos campos só aparece de di.en: The field hummingbird only shows up by day, near the yellow flowers. At night it sleeps curled up like a nut.

Acampamento de inverno! Barraca, fogueir.en: Winter camp! Tent, campfire and a battle to warm up!

O lago congelado do campo tem um tesouro.en: The frozen lake in the field has a treasure in the middle. Step on the ice and let yourself slide — but aim first!

Mil e oitocentos metros de altura e eu a.en: Eighteen hundred meters up and I still run uphill. Want to see who runs out of breath first?

Perdi eu. O ar daqui é fino..en: I did. The air up here is thin.

Lá do mirante norte, de madrugada, já ou.en: From the north lookout, before dawn, I once heard a song that made the whole forest go silent. The ancients say it's the Uirapuru.

Cuido das araucárias desde menina. Quem.en: I've looked after the araucarias since I was a girl. Whoever steps on green pine nuts gets a scolding — and a battle!

Sacuda as araucárias de tronco grosso: à.en: Shake the thick-trunked araucarias: sometimes a Serelepão falls along with the pine nuts.

Gaita no peito e verso na língua: / quem.en: Accordion at my chest and verse on my tongue: / whoever crosses the field won't escape me, young one!

A gaita desafinou, / e o verso também ac.en: The accordion went out of tune, / and the verse ended too soon.

Rumo norte, depois das pedras, tem uma t.en: Heading north, past the rocks, there's an old fenced-off trail. The Field Guardian only opens it after the Council.

Estudo o solo dos campos de altitude: tu.en: I study the soil of the high fields: peat, moss and Tuco-Escavador. Let's see what you've got underneath!

Escavei e achei a minha derrota..en: I dug and found my defeat.

O Tuquim mora em túneis que parecem um l.en: The Tuquim lives in tunnels that look like a maze. When it evolves, it becomes an Iron miner.

Pescar no gelo é arte: faz o furo, joga.en: Ice fishing is an art: drill the hole, drop the line and wait. I waited for you!

Peguei resfriado em vez de peixe..en: I caught a cold instead of a fish.

O Pinguimar surfa nas ondinhas da lagoa..en: The Pinguimar surfs the lagoon's little waves. Nobody knows how it got to the hills. It won't tell either.

Onda de lagoa é pequena, mas é minha! Re.en: Lagoon waves are small, but they're mine! Paddle, I'll catch you!

Caí da prancha. Na água gelada..en: I fell off the board. Into the icy water.

A Lontra-Veloz desce a cachoeira da lago.en: The Lontra-Veloz goes down the lagoon's waterfall on its back. Show-off.

Só tenho um parceiro. Mas ele canta deba.en: I only have one partner. But it sings underwater and the whole lagoon shakes!

Dizem que, depois que alguém vencer o Co.en: They say that after someone beats the Council, a real whale will sing at the bottom of this lagoon. I believe it.

O Tuiuiú subiu do Pantanal atrás de mim..en: The Tuiuiú came up from the Pantanal after me. Or I came up after it. Doesn't matter: fight!

O Tuiuiú voltou para o Pantanal. Eu fico.en: The Tuiuiú went back to the Pantanal. I'm staying.

A Lavadeira-Dragão pousa nos juncos da m.en: The Lavadeira-Dragão lands on the reeds by the shore. Its wings look like stained glass when the sun hits them.

Cinquenta invernos nesta lagoa. Você é o.en: Fifty winters on this lagoon. You're the first fish that talks!

Ilha do meio? Só de canoa. Lá tem o barr.en: The middle island? Canoe only. That's where my buddy Joca's shack is, a fisher from the Alva family.

Na névoa eu ando de olho fechado. Você a.en: In the fog I walk with my eyes closed. You walk with a Lantern? Then it's a fair challenge!

A trilha sobe pelo pinheiral e desce até.en: The trail goes up through the pines and down to the Canyon Bridge. Don't leave it: the canyon's lack of a bottom is no joke.

O Urutau-Fantasma imita um galho seco. E.en: The Urutau-Fantasma imitates a dry branch. I imitate a calm birdwatcher. Until now!

Voltei a ser galho seco..en: Back to being a dry branch.

De noite, sacuda os pinheiros do mirante.en: At night, shake the pines at the lookout: Noitão comes down to complain and Urutau-Fantasma comes down to scare.

Quem anda na névoa escuta o que não vê:.en: Whoever walks in the fog hears what they can't see: / a verse from afar, and the verse is for thee!

A névoa engoliu meu verso, / e me deixou.en: The fog swallowed my verse, / and turned me in reverse.

O degrau de pedra do campo é atalho de m.en: The stone step in the field is a one-way shortcut. Once you're down, you're down. To go up, go around.

Pesquiso como os bichos se orientam na n.en: I research how critters find their way in the fog. Hypothesis: by the smell of challengers!

O Graxaim-da-Névoa é feito de neblina. G.en: The Graxaim-da-Névoa is made of mist. Spook moves hit it; Normal moves pass right through.

Distintivo de orientação noturna: tenho..en: Night Navigation Badge: got it. Victory Against a Champion Badge: I'm about to win it!

Do outro lado da ponte o capim é tão alt.en: On the other side of the bridge the grass is so tall the fog gets stuck in it. That's where the Jaguatiricão hunts.

Tropa de mula na névoa só anda com sino.en: A mule train in the fog only moves with bells on their necks. My train moves with battles!

Perdi a tropa e a batalha..en: I lost the train and the battle.

Planalto Lume é logo ali. A Astrônoma Ja.en: Planalto Lume is just ahead. Astronomer Jaci plays with Mind critters: bring Spook and Bug.

Meu nome é de bicho e o meu bicho é de n.en: My name is a critter's and my critter is my name's. The Jaguatiricão vanishes in the fog… and appears behind you!

O mirante cercado do nordeste é dos Guar.en: The fenced lookout to the northeast belongs to the Guardians. The watchman says only after the Council.

Capoeira na névoa: o adversário não vê o.en: Capoeira in the fog: your opponent can't see the kick coming. Sometimes neither can I. Iê!

Na beira do Planalto Lume tem roda de ch.en: At the edge of Planalto Lume there's a choro circle, not capoeira. But the ginga is the same.

Três anos para ver um Beija-Arco-Íris! A.en: Three years to see a Beija-Arco-Íris! Now I have one, and it's itching to fight!

Ele voou de volta para as flores..en: It flew back to the flowers.

Nos Campos do Lume, de dia, sacuda os ip.en: In the Lume Fields, by day, shake the ipês: the Jataí-Rainha lives in the hollow trunk.

O Louva-Mestre luta em kata: posição, re.en: The Louva-Mestre fights in kata: stance, breath, strike. Are you breathing?

Respirei fundo. Perdi do mesmo jeito..en: I took a deep breath. Lost anyway.

A Astrônoma Jaci troca de criatura no me.en: Astronomer Jaci switches creatures mid-fight like switching constellations. Have an answer for each one.

Serenata no coreto para a lua e para voc.en: A serenade at the bandstand for the moon and for you: / if I lose, I sing; if I win, I sing too!

Canto a derrota: tem mais rima..en: I'll sing of my defeat: it rhymes better.

O Papagálio aprende qualquer golpe que e.en: The Papagálio learns any move it hears. Don't talk strategy around it.

Dezesseis insígnias? Bonito. Aqui em cim.en: Sixteen badges? Nice. Up here they weigh twice as much. Let's see if you can carry the weight!

A trilha sobe em zigue-zague. Cada curva.en: The trail zigzags up. Every bend has a mountaineer who wants to prove something. Me included.

Lição de escoteira para o Pico: sempre l.en: Scout lesson for the Peak: always bring extra medicine. Lesson two: never turn down a challenge!

Lição três: perder também conta como exp.en: Lesson three: losing counts as experience too.

O campo de gelo do oeste tem um prêmio n.en: The west ice field has a prize at the edge. Slide in a straight line and stop at the rock.

A Harpia vê um tatu a um quilômetro. E v.en: The Harpia can spot an armadillo a kilometer away. And it can see you much closer!

A Harpia piscou. Eu chorei um pouquinho..en: The Harpia blinked. I cried a little.

A gruta do leste tem uma fenda que sai n.en: The east cave has a crack that comes out on a hidden ledge. A big bat lives in there.

Roda de capoeira no topo do Brasil! O be.en: A capoeira roda at the top of Brazil! The berimbau up here echoes all the way to the sea!

O Coronel Garrote passou por aqui com do.en: Colonel Garrote came through here with two goons and a chain. Went straight to the Summit.

Sou aprendiz do Guardião Cauã. Ele mando.en: I'm Guardian Cauã's apprentice. He told me to test whoever comes up. Don't take it personally!

Vou contar ao Cauã que você é bom. Ele v.en: I'll tell Cauã you're good. He'll smile. He almost never smiles.

O Conselho tem cinco Guardiões, um atrás.en: The Council has five Guardians, one after another. Iara, Cauã, Jandaia, Moacir and High Guardian Arandu.

Já subi o Pico quarenta vezes. Nunca ent.en: I've climbed the Peak forty times. Never got into the Hall. Today I'll at least beat someone who will!

O Guardião Tibiriçá deixou dois Elixires.en: Guardian Tibiriçá left two Elixirs and two Guaraná Teas at the Gate exit. It's the offering for those who climb.

O Coronel mandou ninguém subir! Principa.en: The Colonel said nobody goes up! Especially YOU!

O Coronel vai me demitir de novo..en: The Colonel's going to fire me again.

Ele está lá em cima, na porta do Salão..en: He's up there, at the Hall door. Says the rarest creatures in Pingorama are inside.

Última capanga antes do Coronel! Corrent.en: Last goon before the Colonel! New chain, new gourd, old grudge!

Eu só queria um emprego com vista para a.en: I just wanted a job with a mountain view. I got one with a view of defeat.

Esta floresta é mais velha que as cidade.en: This forest is older than the towns. Whoever comes in, comes in to learn. Lesson number one: respect!

Os Ninhos Raros ficam nas clareiras: cad.en: The Rare Nests are in the clearings: each one with the offspring of one of the three first trainer partners.

Pesquiso a megafauna: preguiça-gigante,.en: I research megafauna: giant sloths, car-sized armadillos… and the Mapinguari, which nobody's seen and everybody's heard.

O Mapinguari só aparece no coração da fl.en: The Mapinguari only appears in the heart of the forest, after the Council recognizes a new Champion. Bring a Gold Gourd and patience.

A Harpia daqui tem penacho de rainha. A.en: The Harpia here has a queen's crest. Mine looks like it's about to win!

De madrugada, a clareira dos ipês enche.en: Before dawn, the ipê clearing fills with hummingbirds. Even the rainbow one.

Capoeira de raiz, na floresta de raiz! E.en: Roots capoeira, in a forest of roots! Get in the roda, Champ!

Raiz arrancada. Ainda bem que cresce de.en: Root pulled up. Good thing it grows back.

O revanche do Conselho vale a pena: cada.en: The Council rematch is worth it: every time you win, the Summit wanderer comes back to the top.

O rio da floresta não tem nome no mapa..en: The forest river has no name on the map. It has caimans the size of canoes. And me, the size of the challenge!

O jacaré me olhou com pena..en: The caiman looked at me with pity.

Na lagoa escura do sul, de canoa, às vez.en: In the dark lagoon to the south, by canoe, a Jacaruçu sometimes swims by. Don't reach out your hand.

Ê, camará! Na Trilha da Roda ninguém pas.en: Hey, camará! Nobody crosses the Trilha da Roda without playing. Come on, the berimbau's already calling!

Jogo bonito. Perdi, mas perdi com ginga..en: Beautiful game. I lost, but I lost with ginga.

Na roda o Mestre Gingado manda criatura.en: In the roda, Master Gingado sends creatures in pairs. Practice switching yours on the right beat.

Saí de Arraial Brasa tocando três bichos.en: I left Arraial Brasa driving three critters and you cut right in front of the herd!

A boiada parou para ver. Até a Seriemão.en: The herd stopped to watch. Even the Seriemão clapped.

Desça pelo degrau de terra do capinzal:.en: Go down the dirt step in the grassland: it's one-way, but it saves you the whole loop.

Psiu! Um Tucanuçu pousou no ipê. E agora.en: Shh! A Tucanuçu landed on the ipê. And now it's going to land on your team!

Voou. E levou a minha dignidade no bico..en: It flew off. And took my dignity in its beak.

O Quero-Guarda grita quando alguém chega.en: The Quero-Guarda screams when someone gets near its nest. It screamed at you. I got the message.

No alto do Tabuleiro a rima é mais fina:.en: Up on the Tableland the rhyme is more refined: / whoever climbs without a duel gets left behind!

Perdi o duelo e perdi a rima, / desço a.en: I lost the duel and I lost the rhyme, / I'll head down the slope and not look up this time.

O Papagálio aprende tudo o que a gente f.en: The Papagálio learns everything we say. That's why I only speak in verse around it.

Meu Prego-Mestre quebra coco com pedra..en: My Prego-Mestre cracks coconuts with rocks. Imagine what it'll do to your defense!

Quebrou foi a minha estratégia..en: The only thing cracked was my strategy.

O Bugio-Trovão mora nas árvores grossas.en: Bugio-Trovão lives in the thick trees around here. Shake one and get ready for the noise.

Saúva-Rainha não perde formigueiro, e eu.en: A Saúva-Rainha never loses an anthill, and I never lose a battle. Usually.

Atrás do cipó do oeste tem um bosque com.en: Behind the west vines there's a grove with planting beds. Fruit planted there grows in shade and peace.

Distintivo de Trilha: conquistado. Disti.en: Trail Badge: earned. Battle Against a Champion Badge: now!

Ganhei o distintivo de Boa Perdedora. Ta.en: I earned the Good Loser badge. That counts too.

Escoteira sempre alerta: tem uma lagoa l.en: A scout is always alert: there's a lagoon up above the waterfall. Nobody goes up without the Waterfall Charm.

Trouxe a forja nas costas até aqui. Agor.en: I carried my forge on my back all the way here. Now you'll feel its heat!

A brasa apagou. Volto para o Arraial rea.en: The embers went out. I'm heading back to the Arraial to relight them.

Cidade Ginga tem tudo, menos forja. Por.en: Cidade Ginga has everything except a forge. That's why I bring mine.

Na praça da roda o desafio é aberto. Que.en: In the roda square the challenge is open. Set foot in the sand and you're playing!

Saí da roda pela tangente. Boa, camará..en: I slipped out of the roda on a tangent. Nice one, camará.

O Mestre Gingado escuta o berimbau antes.en: Master Gingado listens to the berimbau before calling a move. You should listen too.

Vou te mostrar a meia-lua da minha Arira.en: I'll show you my Ariranhão's half-moon kick. It learned it swimming!

Meia-lua, lua inteira, eclipse. Perdi..en: Half moon, full moon, eclipse. I lost.

Tipo Ginga perde força contra Vento, Men.en: Brawl types lose strength against Wind, Mind, Poison, Bug and Charm. Choose carefully who enters the roda.

Maré.ctx: src/data/treinadores/b2-sul.ts:43 · t() | src/data/treinadores/b2-sul.ts:45 · t() | src/data/treinadores/liga.ts:53 · mestre()

Quer entrar na Roda Grande? Primeiro pas.en: Want to join the Big Roda? First you get past me. The berimbau's playing São Bento Grande: it's a tough game!

O berimbau mudou o toque. Para você..en: The berimbau changed its rhythm. For you.

Sábado a Roda Grande é aberta. Volte qua.en: On Saturdays the Big Roda is open. Come back once Gaúcha Pinhão has given you the Flake Badge and we'll play again, with the grown-up team.

Sábado de Roda Grande! A equipe treinou.en: Big Roda Saturday! The team trained all week. Hey, round the world, camará!

A volta do mundo deu a volta em mim..en: The round-the-world went right around me.

Sábado que vem tem mais. A roda não acab.en: More next Saturday. The roda never ends: it just rests.

Blub! Batalha debaixo d'água: quem respi.en: Blub! Underwater battle: whoever breathes first loses!

Blub… blub… perdi o fôlego e a luta..en: Blub… blub… I lost my breath and the fight.

Suba nas clareiras de luz do fundo. A da.en: Surface at the patches of light at the bottom. The one in the cave has air and a hermit who loves visitors.

A minha Arraião se esconde na areia do f.en: My Arraião hides in the sand at the bottom. You didn't even see it coming!

Agora quem se esconde na areia sou eu..en: Now I'm the one hiding in the sand.

Este trecho do túnel termina no charco d.en: This stretch of the tunnel ends at the Brejo Roxo marsh. They say the water there runs purple because of a tannery.

O Polvão muda de cor para enganar. Eu mu.en: Polvão changes color to trick you. I change strategy. Let's see who tricks who!

Fui eu que fiquei com cara de polvo..en: I'm the one left red-faced as an octopus.

Pirarucão e Minhocão aparecem pouco aqui.en: Pirarucão and Minhocão rarely show up down here. Whoever has patience and a Net Gourd leaves smiling.

Trinta anos pescando neste lago escuro!.en: Thirty years fishing this dark lake! The Jaú-Gigante is practically my business partner.

O sócio me abandonou..en: My partner walked out on me.

Com Vara Mestra o Jaú morde mais. Com Va.en: With a Master Rod the Jaú bites more. With an Old Rod you only get Mandizinho, but Mandizinho grows.

Subi a trepadeira para garimpar a pratel.en: I climbed the creepers to prospect the ledge. Nobody comes up here without getting a challenge!

Ganhou de mim e da altura..en: You beat me and the height.

Tem um nicho atrás da rocha rachada. Eu.en: There's a nook behind the cracked rock. I forgot my Rock Smash Charm at home. You didn't, right?

Estou contando sapos para provar que o b.en: I'm counting frogs to prove the swamp is sick. You're about to become a statistic!

A Coralzinha tem anéis que brilham. Boni.en: The Coralzinha has glowing rings. Pretty, but don't get close without Pure Honey in your bag.

Pesco no charco desde que o charco era l.en: I've fished this marsh since it was a lagoon. Purple fish, but I fish!

O Jacaruçu do charco é parente do Jacare.en: The marsh Jacaruçu is related to the Pantanal Jacaretinga. Just older and grumpier.

Ei, ei! O curtume está fechado. Para obr.en: Hey, hey! The tannery is closed. For renovations. Renovations of… tannery. Move along!

Tá bom, tá bom! Entra. Mas eu não deixei.en: Fine, fine! Go in. But I didn't let you, got it?

Eu vou dizer que você me enganou com um.en: I'll say you tricked me with a disguise.

Visita no depósito? A Doutora Zinabre nã.en: A visitor in the storage room? Doctor Zinabre doesn't like visitors. Neither do I!

A Doutora vai descontar do meu salário..en: The Doctor's going to dock my pay.

Salário… que salário? O Cartel paga em p.en: Pay… what pay? The Cartel pays in promises.

Encostou nas jaulas? Encostou no Cartel.en: Touched the cages? You touched the Rust Cartel!

A alavanca da sala de máquinas abre a po.en: The lever in the machine room opens the hallway door. Forget I said that.

Ninguém mexe na alavanca enquanto eu est.en: Nobody touches the lever while I'm on guard!

Pode mexer. Eu vou tomar um café..en: Go ahead. I'm going for a coffee.

O café daqui tem gosto de peçonha. Tudo.en: The coffee here tastes like venom. Everything here tastes like venom.

O nível 2 é das jaulas. E você vai para.en: Level 2 is for cages. And you're going into one!

Quem foi para a jaula foi o meu orgulho..en: The only thing that went into a cage was my pride.

O Doutor Peçonha está numa cela lá no ca.en: Doctor Peçonha is in a cell over in the corner. He whistles all day long. Maddening.

Destilaria do Cartel! Aqui a gente trans.en: Cartel distillery! Here we turn venom into money.

E eu transformei uma batalha em vergonha.en: And I turned a battle into shame.

A alavanca B fica aqui atrás. A A fica n.en: Lever B is back here. Lever A is in the cage wing. The two of them open the core.

Você soltou alguma criatura? Fala a verd.en: Did you let any creatures out? Tell the truth!

O Projeto Caipora é ideia do Coronel Gar.en: Project Caipora is Colonel Garrote's idea. A creature that makes brush sprout from concrete is worth more than a gold mine.

Trio de peçonha! Medusão, Cascavelão e V.en: Venom trio! Medusão, Cascavelão and Vampirinha. Pick where the pain comes from.

O tenente Lata veio da Usina para comand.en: Lieutenant Lata came from the Power Plant to run the core. He still tells the story of how he lost to you.

Ninguém passa da comporta! Eu sou a últi.en: Nobody gets past the floodgate! I'm the last line of defense!

Fui a última linha. Agora sou a primeira.en: I was the last line. Now I'm the first to run.

Lá embaixo está a jaula reforçada. Eu nu.en: The reinforced cage is down below. I never go near it: the creature looks at me like I'm brush to be cleared.

Uma criança da Costa no meu núcleo? Inte.en: A kid from the Coast in my core? Interesting. I'll use you in the next phase of the venom tests!

Impossível… a curva de resistência dela.en: Impossible… her resistance curve was in my charts!

Você de novo! Desde a Usina eu sonho com.en: You again! I've dreamed of this rematch since the Power Plant. Back there it was old rust; here it's new iron!

Ferro novo… enferrujou do mesmo jeito. O.en: New iron… rusted all the same. The Colonel's going to have me sweep the Peak.

Estudo cobras há vinte anos. Agora vou e.en: I've studied snakes for twenty years. Now I'll study you!

Conclusão da pesquisa: fui picada pela d.en: Research conclusion: I got bitten by defeat.

A Jararacuçu enxerga calor. A Coralzinha.en: The Jararacuçu sees heat. The Coralzinha glows at night. This Herpetologist loses by day and by night.

A mata dos marimbondos fica atrás do cip.en: The hornet woods are behind the vines. Before that, you go through my woods of challenges!

Fui picada pela minha própria Marimbondã.en: I got stung by my own Marimbondão.

Sacuda as árvores de tronco grosso devag.en: Shake the thick-trunked trees slowly. Marimbondão doesn't like to be rushed.

Vim de canoa e fiquei na ilha. A canoa f.en: I came by canoe and got stuck on the island. The canoe left on its own. Battle to pass the time?

Se você vir a minha canoa por aí, diga q.en: If you see my canoe out there, tell it I forgive it.

Toco boiada no brejo há anos. Jacaruçu é.en: I've been herding in the swamp for years. Jacaruçu is my pet steer!

O boi de estimação foi estimar outro don.en: My pet steer went off to be someone else's pet.

A passarela atravessa a Lagoa Roxa. Quem.en: The boardwalk crosses the Lagoa Roxa. Whoever falls in the water becomes Piranhão dinner.

As garças do Vale voltaram depois que o.en: The Vale egrets came back after the tannery stopped! I'll celebrate with a battle!

Tuiuiú no brejo é sinal de água limpa vo.en: A Tuiuiú in the swamp is a sign clean water is coming back. At least in its little corner.

Garimpando no charco de lama! A pepita m.en: Prospecting in the mud marsh! The prettiest nugget is down here. Or not. Battle!

O Covil das Cobras tem uma rocha rachada.en: The Snake Den has a cracked rock at the entrance. Inside, they say, a real nugget shines.

No Vale do Veneno quem canta é o sapo: /.en: In the Vale do Veneno the frog sings the tune: / but today I'm the one singing, and I'll eat you soon!

O sapo voltou a cantar sozinho, / e eu v.en: The frog's back to singing all on its own, / and I'm heading back quietly, alone.

De noite o Gambarrão sai do mato com os.en: At night the Gambarrão comes out of the brush with its babies on its back. Respect the family.

Acampamento na ilha do sul! A Sucurião é.en: Camping on the south island! The Sucurião is the tent's bodyguard.

Distintivo de Sobrevivência no Brejo: co.en: Swamp Survival Badge: earned. Victory Badge: maybe next time.

Primeiro patamar! Daqui até a Serra da G.en: First landing! From here to Serra da Geada there are four cliffs. And me!

Fiquei no primeiro patamar..en: I stayed on the first landing.

Trepadeira se sobe com Escalar. Pedregul.en: Creepers are climbed with Climb. Boulders in a crack are pushed with Strength. Ledges you hop down.

Tropa de mula subindo e um Campeão desce.en: A mule train going up and a Champion going down? No: going up too! Then let's race!

A tropa passa na frente. Você passa na f.en: The train goes first. You go ahead of the train.

Lá no alto tem um homem que fala de pinh.en: Up top there's a man who talks about pine nuts like they're gold. That's Seu Pinhão-Manso.

Distintivo de Araucária: plante uma, gan.en: Araucaria Badge: plant one, earn one. Battle Badge: beat me!

O Serelepão guarda pinhão para o inverno.en: The Serelepão stores pine nuts for winter. Shake the araucarias at the top and it'll drop out in fright.

A Harpia é a rainha do céu. E eu sou a r.en: The Harpia is the queen of the sky. And I'm the queen of this trail!

A rainha caiu do trono..en: The queen fell off her throne.

Daqui do alto dá para ver a Lagoa Gelada.en: From up here you can see the Lagoa Gelada shining. Or it's frost. In the hills everything shines.

Rocha rachada na serra é presente! Tem M.en: A cracked rock in the hills is a gift! There's Mocó, there's Tuco and there's an angry trainer!

A gruta do mocó, no patamar do meio, abr.en: The mocó cave, on the middle landing, opens with Rock Smash. Inside there's a nugget I couldn't reach.

A cerração sobe da serra de noite. Junto.en: The mist rises from the hills at night. And with it, me and my Graxaim-da-Névoa!

A névoa se dissipou. E eu junto..en: The mist cleared. And so did I.

O Caminho das Névoas, depois da Serra da.en: The Caminho das Névoas, past Serra da Geada, is much worse. Bring the Lantern.

A araucária leva duzentos anos para cres.en: An araucaria takes two hundred years to grow. My patience takes two seconds!

Acabou a paciência e a batalha..en: Out of patience and out of battle.

Pinhão que cai no chão e ninguém pega vi.en: A pine nut that falls and no one picks up becomes a tree. The Gralha-Azul is what plants the hills.

Buenas, vivente! Payada se responde com.en: Buenas, partner! A payada is answered with a payada, / and a battle is answered with a smack in the face… of the opponent, I'd say!

O vivente venceu e a payada parou, / o M.en: The partner won and the payada came to a stop, / the Minuano wind took whatever I'd got.

O vento Minuano sopra frio do sul. Quand.en: The Minuano wind blows cold from the south. When it arrives, Gaúcha Pinhão smiles.

Pesquisa de altitude: como as criaturas.en: Altitude research: how do creatures cope with the cold? Practical test!

Resultado: elas se viram melhor do lado.en: Result: they cope better on your side.

A Lavadeira-Dragão apareceu aqui por cau.en: The Lavadeira-Dragão showed up here because of the dry waterfall. It likes places the water has already passed.

Buenas, tchê! Quem chega na serra, prova.en: Buenas, tchê! Whoever reaches the hills tries the chimarrão and the brawl. We start with the brawl!

Bah, que peleia! Agora sim, o chimarrão..en: Bah, what a brawl! Now, the chimarrão.

A Gaúcha Pinhão treina no gelo. O segred.en: Gaúcha Pinhão trains on ice. The secret is not being afraid to slip.

A minha Pinguimar surfa na geada! Vamos.en: My Pinguimar surfs on frost! Let's see if your team can take the cold!

Pinguim na serra parece mentira. Os da L.en: Penguins in the hills sounds like a fib. The ones at Lagoa Gelada came with a cold front and stayed.

{JOGADOR}! Subi a serra pela trilha dos.en: {JOGADOR}! I climbed the hills by the drovers' trail just to get here before you. I made it! Since the Arraial I've trained in the roda, in the swamp and in the ice. Gaúcha Pinhão is next — but first, you!

Bah… até o sotaque daqui eu peguei, meno.en: Bah… I picked up the local accent, just not the win. But I can feel it: I'm getting close.

Dezesseis insígnias… Então é você que fe.en: Sixteen badges… So you're the one who shuts down my power plants, frees my nests and blows up my labs. Know what's inside that Hall? Five old-timers and the biggest collection of rare creatures in Pingorama. I came to take it. And you came to get in my way for the last time!

Impossível… Uma criança e um punhado de.en: Impossible… A child and a handful of backwoods critters. The Rust Cartel… ends here. But remember: as long as there are people who want cages, there'll be people who want to sell them.

{JOGADOR}! Eu vi o Garrote descendo a tr.en: {JOGADOR}! I saw Garrote heading down the trail in handcuffs with the Guardians. You did that, right? Of course you did. Before you go in there, one last time: you and me, full teams, like that first morning in Prof. Ipê's lab. No being-tired excuses!

Pronto. Agora eu sei: você não é o meu r.en: There. Now I know: you're not my rival. You're my yardstick. Go in there and show them what the Coast and the Sertão raised.

Eu sou Iara Costa, Guardiã do Mar. Guard.en: I am Iara Costa, Sea Guardian. I guard the rivers that run down the mountains and the sea that receives them. Water is never in a hurry, {JOGADOR}: it goes around, it waits and, when the flood comes, it carries everything away. Let's see if you can swim.

A maré virou, e virou bonita. Siga: o Ca.en: The tide turned, and turned beautifully. Go on: Cauã has already heard your footsteps in the forest.

Cauã, Guardião da Mata. Cada árvore dest.en: Cauã, Forest Guardian. Every tree on these mountains knows me by name. In the forest nobody fights alone: the ant, the tapir and the tortoise work together. Show me your team is a forest too!

A mata abriu caminho para você. Isso ela.en: The forest made way for you. It doesn't do that for just anyone. Jandaia awaits in the sky.

Jandaia, Guardiã do Céu! Daqui de cima e.en: Jandaia, Sky Guardian! From up here I watch the clouds being born. Two wins and you're still standing? Then hold on to your hat, because up here it blows, it thunders and lightning strikes!

Que tempestade foi essa? Foi a sua. Pass.en: What storm was that? It was yours. Go on: Moacir is patient as stone, but he doesn't like to wait.

Moacir. Guardião da Terra. Sou o chão on.en: Moacir. Earth Guardian. I am the ground you've walked on since you left home. One… two… three… I count slowly because stone is never in a hurry. Let's see how long you last under the mountain.

A montanha tremeu. Faz tempo que isso nã.en: The mountain shook. It's been a long time since that happened. Go, the High Guardian has known your name since you were born.

Arandu quer dizer \"o que guarda a memór.en: Arandu means "the one who keeps memory". I keep all of Pingorama's: Iara's sea, Cauã's forest, Jandaia's sky, Moacir's earth. You came from Vila Jacarandá to the top of the world, {JOGADOR}. Now show me what you learned along the way — with everything you've got.

Eis a memória nova de Pingorama. Você e.en: Behold Pingorama's newest memory. You and your creatures fight like those who care. That's what the Council was waiting for.

Guardiã da Prova.ctx: src/data/treinadores/ginasio-16.ts:9 · campo classe | src/data/treinadores/ginasio-16.ts:15 · campo classe | src/data/treinadores/ginasio-16.ts:21 · campo classe

Cheguei ao terceiro Mestre mês passado..en: I made it to the third Master last month. I'm working up the courage to go back. Help me warm up?

Esquentei até demais..en: I warmed up a little too much.

A Mestra Maré envenena primeiro e alaga.en: Master Maré poisons first and floods after. Bring Pure Honey and someone Earth or Mind: Thunder alone won't handle hers.

Treino aqui para o Brasa-Viva. Ferro com.en: I train here for Brasa-Viva. Iron on iron: hit me, I want to hear the clang!

O Brasa-Viva tem Brasa e tem Ferro. Terr.en: Brasa-Viva has Ember and Iron. Earth hits both; River puts out half. Just don't send Grass or Bug into the forge.

Um verso antes da luta: quem entra na ne.en: A verse before the fight: who walks into the fog / not knowing whence they came / leaves telling their own tale / only halfway, all the same!

Perdi o fio do verso..en: I lost the thread of my verse.

O Pajé Neblina faz dormir e confunde. Po.en: Shaman Neblina puts you to sleep and confuses you. Copaiba Balm cures everything at once, and Spook moves hit his squarely.

Eita! Campeão de oito insígnias no meu t.en: Whoa! An eight-badge Champion in my yard? Then hold on for a warm-up rodeo!

A Pampa bate de perto e bate forte. Vent.en: Pampa hits up close and hits hard. Wind, Mind and Charm take down her Brawl; Spook doesn't even feel Normal moves.

Vim de Vila Buriti atrás de você. A Dona.en: I came from Vila Buriti after you. Dona Buriti says to tell you strong roots prove themselves in a drought!

Secou. A raiz era a sua..en: Dried up. The strong root was yours.

São cinco lutas sem Posto. Chá de Guaran.en: That's five battles with no Post. Guaraná Tea gets the fallen back up; Elixir refills health in one go. Spend your money at the Shop BEFORE going in.

Perdi para o Cacique três vezes. Aprendi.en: I lost to the Chief three times. I learned his moves by heart. Want to see? Then fight!

O Cacique abre com o Gaviãozão, paralisa.en: The Chief opens with Gaviãozão, paralyzes with Poraquê and saves Pirarucão for last. Charm and Frost get Legend good.

Sou a Maré, primeira Mestra. No mangue a.en: I'm Maré, the first Master. In the mangrove the water rises slowly, and by the time you notice it's up to your neck. That's my team: poison first, flood after!

A maré virou… e virou para o seu lado. P.en: The tide turned… and it turned your way. Go on, challenger: Brasa-Viva's forge is already lit.

Brasa-Viva, segundo Mestre! Sino bom se.en: Brasa-Viva, second Master! A good bell is made by hammering: iron in the coals, hammer on the iron. Let's see what alloy your team is made of!

Rachou o meu sino… e que som bonito ele.en: You cracked my bell… and what a lovely sound it made. Go, the Shaman's fog is waiting for you.

Sente, desafiante. Eu sou o Neblina, e t.en: Sit down, challenger. I'm Neblina, and every battle of mine starts with a story: once upon a time a team walked into this room… and couldn't remember how it left.

Essa história eu não conhecia: a do desa.en: That's a story I didn't know: the one about the challenger who crossed the fog. I'll tell it to my grandchildren. Pampa is the next gate.

Eita, chegou longe! Sou a Pampa, última.en: Whoa, you got far! I'm Pampa, the last gate before the Champion. My critters aren't tamed by shouting: they're tamed by rhythm. Hold on tight, the rodeo's about to start!

Me derrubou da sela, e com classe! Atrás.en: You knocked me out of the saddle, and with style! Behind that door is Chief Aracê. Take off your hat when you go in.

Aracê quer dizer \"o nascer do dia\". Há.en: Aracê means "the break of day". For twenty years I've watched the sun rise from this Platô, and for twenty years nobody has moved me from here. You brought eight badges and beat four Masters. One dawn to go. Show me your whole team, {JOGADOR}!

O sol… nasceu do outro lado hoje. Vinte.en: The sun… rose on the other side today. Twenty years! And I lost smiling. You and your creatures fight like you're having a conversation.

CAMPEÃO?! Você?! Eu estava presa no terc.en: CHAMPION?! You?! I was stuck at the third Master and heard the Platô bell ring for YOU! No, no, no. Before any party, {JOGADOR}: you and me, here, now. Full team!

Tá. Tá bom! Você é o Campeão e eu sou… a.en: Fine. Fine! You're the Champion and I'm… next. Write it down: NEXT.

Perdi para o Pajé Neblina. As criaturas.en: I lost to Shaman Neblina. His creatures put you to sleep and then haunt your dreams.

Leve criatura do tipo Assombro ou de Men.en: Bring a Spook-type creature or a strong Mind one. And Copaiba Balm. Lots of it.

Salve o jogo antes de entrar, descanse a.en: Save before you go in, rest your team and check your bag.

Parece conselho de mãe. É que a minha mã.en: Sounds like a mom's advice. That's because my mom was a League Master.

Última venda antes da glória! Ou da verg.en: Last shop before glory! Or shame. Either way, take some Elixir.

São cinco lutas sem descanso: os golpes.en: That's five battles with no rest: the good moves run out before the creatures do. Cane Juice restores one spent move.

Custa os olhos da cara. Mas contra o Cam.en: It costs an arm and a leg. But against the Champion, an arm and a leg is pocket change.

PLATÔ DA LIGA DOS GUARDIÕES\nQuatro Mest.en:
LEAGUE OF GUARDIANS PLATÔ
Four Masters and a Champion. Eight badges to get in; courage to stay.

POSTO GUARDIÃO DO PLATÔ\nCure-se AQUI. L.en:
PLATÔ GUARDIAN POST
Heal up HERE. Inside, only what fits in your bag.

VENDA DO PLATÔ\nPreço de altitude. Recla.en:
PLATÔ SHOP
High-altitude prices. Complaints: go down the mountain.

REGRAS DA LIGA\n1. Entrou, não volta. 2.en:
LEAGUE RULES
1. Once in, no going back.  2. Five battles in a row.  3. Healing by items only.
4. Lose, and start over from the first Master.  5. No crying on the carpet.

Estátua de um Campeão antigo. A placa di.en: Statue of a Champion of old. The plaque just says: "Made it here. So can you."

O Marco do Hall da Fama. Os nomes dos Ca.en: The Hall of Fame Marker. The names of the Champions of Costa do Sol are carved from top to bottom.

Alto! Sou o Guardião da Entrada. Daqui p.en: Halt! I'm the Guardian of the Entrance. From here up is the League Platô. Show me your case… You're missing badges. It's EIGHT, buddy: one from each gym in Costa do Sol. Come back when your case is full.

A porta da sala de espera trancou atrás.en: The waiting room door locked behind you. In the League you only move forward.

A porta só abre para quem vencer a Mestr.en: The door only opens for those who beat Master Maré.

A porta só abre para quem vencer o Ferre.en: The door only opens for those who beat Smith Brasa-Viva.

A porta só abre para quem vencer o Pajé.en: The door only opens for those who beat Shaman Neblina.

A porta do Hall da Fama só se abre pelas.en: The Hall of Fame door only opens by the Champion's hand.

A porta só abre para quem vencer a Domad.en: The door only opens for those who beat Tamer Pampa. On the other side waits the Champion.

Maré mistura Rio com Veneno; Brasa-Viva,.en: Maré mixes River with Poison; Brasa-Viva, Ember with Iron; Neblina, Mind with Spook; Pampa, Normal with Brawl.

O Cacique Aracê usa de tudo um pouco, e.en: Chief Aracê uses a bit of everything, and saves a Legend-type creature for last. Charm and Frost scare Legend.

Eu venho todo dia ver quem entra. Sair p.en: I come every day to see who goes in. I've seen few come out the front door.

Você tem cara de quem sai. Ou de quem vo.en: You look like someone who'll come out. Or come back fast. One of the two.

CERRADO ABERTO\nA estrada dá a volta no.en:
CERRADO ABERTO
The road loops around the tall grass and comes back here. You can't get lost. (People have.)

MESA DE PEDRA\nSubida só para quem tem o.en:
STONE MESA
Climb only with the Climb Charm.

CLAREIRA DA DONA RAIZEIRA\nO cipó cresce.en:
DONA RAIZEIRA'S CLEARING
The vines grew back. Bring a machete and goodwill.

GROTÃO DO PEDREGULHO\nA pedra rolou na ú.en:
BOULDER HOLLOW
The rock rolled down in the last rain. Push it with Strength (and finesse).

LAGOA DO CERRADO\nBebedouro das emas. Fa.en:
CERRADO LAGOON
The rheas' watering hole. Please don't compete with them.

Um totem antigo, com um tamanduá entalha.en: An ancient totem with a carved anteater. Someone left ipê flowers at its base.

O Emaçu corre mais que o trem!.en: Emaçu runs faster than the train!

Eu apostei corrida com um. Ele nem perce.en: I raced one once. It didn't even notice it was a race. To the east is the way down to the Pantanal.

Tá vendo essas rochas rachadas e os cupi.en: See these cracked rocks and old termite mounds? There are critters living inside.

Com o Amuleto Quebra-pedra da Dona Benta.en: With Dona Benta Sombra's Rock Smash Charm you can open them. Inside live Cupinzeiro-Vivo, Saúva-Rainha and, if you're lucky, a Minhocão.

De noite o cerrado acende: Vagalampo, Gr.en: At night the cerrado lights up: Vagalampo, Grilão-Elétrico, Bruxaluz…

E o Urutau-Fantasma finge que é galho. S.en: And the Urutau-Fantasma pretends to be a branch. Shake the thick-trunked trees after sunset.

Naquela ilhota tem coisa brilhando. Bril.en: Something's been shining on that islet. It's shone since I was a girl.

Nunca fui ver. Cada um tem o mistério qu.en: I never went to look. Everyone gets the mystery they deserve.

(O Emaçu encara você, pisca devagar e vo.en: (The Emaçu stares at you, blinks slowly and goes back to pecking at the grass.)

CHAPADA DOS PAREDÕES\nCinco degraus de p.en:
CHAPADA DOS PAREDÕES
Five stone steps up to Arraial Brasa. Go up by the creepers; come down by the ledges.

CAVERNA VULCÂNICA\nEscuridão total. Chão.en:
CAVERNA VULCÂNICA
Total darkness. Hot ground. Without a Lantern, don't even think about it.
"Here sleeps the fire serpent." — the ancients

ARRAIAL BRASA logo ao norte.\nForjas, fo.en:
ARRAIAL BRASA just to the north.
Forges, the São João bonfire and Smith Labareda's Gym.

Cada paredão tem um pé de trepadeira. Su.en: Every cliff has creepers at its foot. Climb up those. To get down, hop off the ledge at the edge: it's faster and more fun.

A cascata do oeste? Aquilo só se sobe co.en: The west waterfall? That one only goes up with Master Gingado's Waterfall Charm. I tried with a rope. The rope came down first.

Medi o chão da Caverna Vulcânica: quaren.en: I measured the Caverna Vulcânica floor: forty degrees. And rising whenever something big passes through in there.

Os antigos chamam de Boitatá. Ele só aco.en: The ancients call it Boitatá. It only wakes for those who carry the Crystal Badge. Good thing I only brought a thermometer.

CAVERNA VULCÂNICA\nO chão esquenta a cad.en:
CAVERNA VULCÂNICA
The ground gets hotter with every step north. Deep down, the heat breathes.

FLORESTA ANCESTRAL\n\"Ande devagar: aqui.en:
FLORESTA ANCESTRAL
"Walk slowly: every tree here is older than your great-grandpa."
Rare Nests to the west, east and northeast.

LAGOA ESCURA\nÁgua parada, fundo de lama.en:
DARK LAGOON
Still water, muddy bottom. Canoe-sized caimans. Don't reach out your hand.

CORAÇÃO DA FLORESTA\nAqui os antigos ouv.en:
HEART OF THE FOREST
Here the ancients heard the Mapinguari's cry. Respect the silence.

Um tronco caído há séculos, coberto de m.en: A trunk fallen centuries ago, covered in moss, with claw marks as long as an arm. Something very big scratches itself here.

Os Ninhos Raros são dos filhos dos prime.en: The Rare Nests belong to the offspring of the first partners: Tamanduá-Copa, Guaraflama, Botorosa. Each nest takes one visit a day — any more and the mother gets suspicious.

De manhãzinha, às vezes, quem está no ni.en: Early in the morning, sometimes, the one in the nest is the grown critter: Bandeirão, Lobo-Fornalha, Iaraboto. Those are super rare. Bring a Gold Gourd.

A Guardiã da Floresta me deixou aqui par.en: The Forest Warden left me here to watch the entrance. I do. Mostly the mushrooms.

Lá no Coração da Floresta mora o Mapingu.en: In the Heart of the Forest lives the Mapinguari. It only shows itself to those the Council has recognized. Have you been recognized? Then go on. I'll stay here.

Anzóis em caixinhas de fósforo, uma lata.en: Hooks in matchboxes, an empty worm can and a picture of a girl looking through a telescope.

Cartas antigas amarradas com linha de pe.en: Old letters tied with fishing line. All from Planalto Lume. The last one is three months old.

O fogão a lenha mantém o barraco quente..en: The wood stove keeps the shack warm. On top, a pot of boiled pine nuts that never runs out.

O Maracajá-Nevado do Joca se espreguiça.en: Joca's Maracajá-Nevado stretches near the stove and pretends you don't exist.

LAGOA GELADA\nSul: Serra da Geada. Leste.en:
LAGOA GELADA
South: Serra da Geada. East: Campos de Altitude.
Cold water all year round. Paddle to the island and to the reed beach.

CAMPOS DE ALTITUDE →\nCapim dourado e ge.en:
CAMPOS DE ALTITUDE →
Golden grass and frost.

TRAPICHE COMPRIDO\n\"Na ponta, nos dias.en:
LONG PIER
"At the end, on quiet days, the old folks swear you can hear a whale singing at the bottom of the lagoon."

A canoa é sua se a sua criatura de Rio q.en: The canoe is yours if your River creature wants to pull it. In icy water, only River critters will do it.

A ilha do meio é do Joca, pai da Estrela.en: The middle island is Joca's, Estrela-d'Alva's dad from Planalto Lume. He won't leave it, not even to pick up letters.

Estudo as libélulas da praia dos juncos..en: I study the dragonflies on the reed beach. The Lavadeira-Dragão is the rarest: it shows up now and then, with stained-glass wings.

O Tuiuiú também passa por aqui. Ele sobe.en: The Tuiuiú passes through here too. It comes up from the Pantanal in winter, nobody knows why. Maybe it likes the cold.

PANTANAL ALAGADO\nOeste: Cerrado Aberto..en:
PANTANAL ALAGADO
West: Cerrado Aberto. East, via the boardwalks: Pantanal Grande.
South: the rookery (closed off by Cowgirl Zefa).

PASSARELA DO URUCUM\nTábua velha, rio fu.en:
URUCUM BOARDWALK
Old planks, deep river, curious caiman. Walk in the middle.

PANTANAL GRANDE logo a leste.\nPalafitas.en:
PANTANAL GRANDE just to the east.
Stilt houses, cattle and Cowgirl Zefa's Gym.

NINHAL DO PANTANAL\nTuiuiús, garças e co.en:
PANTANAL ROOKERY
Tuiuiús, egrets and spoonbills nest here in the flood season. Do not touch the eggs.

Um peão da Boiadeira Zefa atravessa a ca.en:
One of Cowgirl Zefa's ranch hands blocks the channel with his canoe:
"Hey, Champ! The rookery's closed: there are folks prowling around the eggs and Zefa had it shut." "Her orders: only those with the Clay Badge get through. Rookery critters are big and wild, no place for someone who hasn't beaten the cowgirl yet."

Uma rede de arrasto do Cartel Ferrugem f.en:
A Rust Cartel dragnet closes the channel from bank to bank, tied to iron stakes.
No canoe, no fish, not even a guess gets through.

Lá em cima do Morro do Urucum tem um nin.en: Up on top of Morro do Urucum there's an old Tuiuiú nest and some shiny stones.

Morro de pedra lisa, com trepadeira na f.en: A smooth stone hill, with creepers on the south face. Only those with the Climb Charm can go up.

Contei os ninhos do ninhal: todos os ovo.en: I counted the rookery nests: all the eggs are back and hatching!

Os filhotes que o Cartel tirou dos ninho.en: The chicks the Cartel took from the nests are at the Pantanal Grande Rehab Center. The vet is looking for people to adopt them.

A Zefa mandou agradecer: a rede do Carte.en: Zefa sends her thanks: the Cartel's net is out of the south channel. Porto Pantaneiro is open again.

De lá sai a Estrada Vermelha, que sobe p.en: From there the Estrada Vermelha climbs up to Chapada Rubra. Bring Rock Smash: the road is nothing but cracked rocks.

VEREDA DOS BURITIS\nNorte: Cerrado Abert.en:
VEREDA DOS BURITIS
North: Cerrado Aberto. South: Vila Cascavel.
Where there are buritis, there's water. Where there's water, there are critters.

LAGOA DO CHAPÉU PERDIDO\nA ilhota só se.en:
LOST HAT LAGOON
The islet can only be reached by canoe.

CERCADO DO SEU NICO\nNa ida, siga as por.en:
SEU NICO'S CORRAL
Going: follow the gates. Coming back: hop the ledges.

Rocha rachada. Dá para ouvir o vento pas.en: A cracked rock. You can hear the wind whistling through the cracks.

CERRADO ABERTO logo ao norte.\nCuidado c.en:
CERRADO ABERTO just to the north.
Watch out for the termite mounds: some of them walk.

Vento levou o chapéu de um moço de Vila.en: The wind blew a Vila Cascavel guy's hat onto that islet.

Eu ia buscar, mas minha canoa só anda co.en: I'd go get it, but my canoe only moves with a River creature pulling it. And mine took the day off.

Fiz o cercado em zigue-zague para as ema.en: I built the corral in a zigzag so the rheas wouldn't escape.

As emas pulam por cima. Quem fica dando.en: The rheas just jump over it. I'm the one going around in circles.

Plantei pitanga nos canteiros. Se você p.en: I planted pitanga in the beds. If you plant a fruit, it grows with the clock.

Tem que regar? Tem. Eu rego? Às vezes..en: Does it need watering? It does. Do I water it? Sometimes.

De noite o Graxaim-da-Névoa sai para caç.en: At night the Graxaim-da-Névoa comes out to hunt around here, and the Tucanuçus go to sleep.

Já a Pintada… essa aparece quando quer..en: Now the Pintada… that one shows up when it feels like it. I saw one once. I cried with joy and it left without looking back.

As árvores de tronco grosso escondem Jat.en: The thick-trunked trees hide Jataí-Rainha. Just give them a shake.

Sacudi uma e caiu uma manga na minha cab.en: I shook one and a mango fell on my head. That counts too.

ESTRADA VERMELHA\nOeste: Porto Pantaneir.en:
ESTRADA VERMELHA
West: Porto Pantaneiro. East: Chapada Rubra.
The red dirt stains your boots. The boots will get used to it.

CHAPADA RUBRA logo adiante.\nCidade do g.en:
CHAPADA RUBRA just ahead.
Town of prospectors, the old mine and the Stone Gym.

MESA DO GAVIÃO\nNinho de Gaviãozão no al.en:
MESA DO GAVIÃO
Gaviãozão nest up top. Climbing only with the Climb Charm.

Pedra rachada fecha a estrada em três lu.en: Cracked rocks block the road in three places. Whoever passes with Rock Smash leaves them open, but on the way back the rock grows again.

Pedra que cresce? É o Minhocão por baixo.en: Rocks that grow? It's the Minhocão underneath, pushing. Or it's a drover's tale. Your pick.

Lá no fundo, aquele poço seco tem uma ca.en: Way back, that dry well has a waterfall that only flows upward on a full moon. Fibbing: it flows down, like every waterfall.

Para subir aquilo você precisa do Amulet.en: To climb that you need the Waterfall Charm. To have patience, you need chamomile tea.

TRILHA DA RODA\nOeste: Arraial Brasa · L.en:
TRILHA DA RODA
West: Arraial Brasa · East: Cidade Ginga.
Whoever passes without a ginga pays a forfeit!

CIDADE GINGA logo adiante.\n\"Aqui o chã.en:
CIDADE GINGA just ahead.
"Here the ground is a drum and your feet are the sticks."

O TABULEIRO\nSubida só para quem sabe Es.en:
THE TABLELAND
Climb only if you know how to Climb.
Up top the wind blows poetry.

RIACHO DO ATABAQUE\nA Lagoa de Cima fica.en:
RIACHO DO ATABAQUE
Lagoa de Cima is past the waterfall.
They say only Master Gingado's berimbau teaches you to go up.

Vim do Arraial com a tropa de mulas, mas.en: I came from the Arraial with my mule train, but they balked when they heard the berimbau.

Mula com suingue. Só nesta trilha mesmo..en: Mules with swing. Only on this trail.

Dica de tropeiro: sacuda as árvores de t.en: Drover's tip: shake the thick-trunked trees. Herculão loves to nap up there.

Tá vendo aquela cascata? Lá em cima tem.en: See that waterfall? Up top there's a lagoon with an islet.

Meu finado subia aquilo no braço. Hoje e.en: My late husband climbed that with his bare arms. Nowadays young folks need the Waterfall Charm.

O Mestre Gingado dá um para quem ganha d.en: Master Gingado gives one to whoever beats him. That's all. Easy, right?

♪ Quem tem pressa come cru,\nquem tem Cu.en:
♪ The hasty eat it raw,
with a Gourd you eat it roasted… ♪

Não faz sentido? Rima também cansa, cria.en: Doesn't make sense? Rhyming gets tiring too, friend.

À noite a trilha muda de gente: some o P.en: At night the trail changes crowds: the Papagaiozim vanish and Quatizão show up rummaging through the campfire.

SUBIDA DA SERRA\nNorte: Serra da Geada..en:
SUBIDA DA SERRA
North: Serra da Geada. Creeper cliffs and boulder cracks.
Climb slowly; come down by the ledges.

TRILHA DO PICO PINGORAMA ↑\nA oeste, dep.en:
PICO PINGORAMA TRAIL ↑
To the west, past the big creeper.
The Peak Guide only takes those with all sixteen badges.

Um vento gelado desce do Pico e empurra.en: An icy wind comes down from the Peak and pushes {JOGADOR} back. Up there, the Guardians' Gate only opens for those with all sixteen badges.

Guia do Pico Carijó: \"A trilha do Pico.en: Peak Guide Carijó: "The Pico Pingorama trail starts at this creeper. Up there the wind knocks down even hawks." "The Guardians' Gate only opens for those with all sixteen badges. Before that, the mountain takes you instead."

Subo esta serra toda semana levando erva.en: I climb these hills every week carrying yerba mate. The mules go up the trail; I go up complaining.

Pedregulho na fenda? Peça para uma criat.en: Boulder in a crack? Ask an Earth, Stone or Brawl creature to push it. Creepers? Brawl, Normal or Bug can climb.

O Pico Pingorama fica entre os dois mapa.en: Pico Pingorama sits between the two maps, above everything. At the top, the Guardians wait for whoever gathers all sixteen badges.

Pelo lado da Costa, a subida é pelo Mont.en: From the Coast side, the climb is via Monte Tupã. From here, it's via the big creeper.

CAMINHO DAS NÉVOAS\nOeste: Serra da Gead.en:
CAMINHO DAS NÉVOAS
West: Serra da Geada · East: Planalto Lume.
In the fog, keep your Lantern lit and your feet on the trail.

PLANALTO LUME logo adiante.\nObservatóri.en:
PLANALTO LUME just ahead.
Observatory, canyons and Astronomer Jaci's Gym.

MIRANTE DO PINHEIRAL\nDaqui se vê o câni.en:
PINE GROVE LOOKOUT
From here you can see the whole canyon — when the fog allows. It almost never does.

Um totem antigo de madeira de lei, cober.en: An ancient hardwood totem, covered in lichen. It faces Pico Pingorama like someone waiting.

O Guarda da Névoa finca o cajado no meio.en:
The Fog Guard plants his staff in the middle of the trail:
"East of here the fog never ends, and the canyon doesn't forgive a wrong step." "Only those carrying Gaúcha Pinhão's Flake Badge and a Lantern to part the fog get through. Come back when you have both."

Um velho vigia de poncho guarda a portei.en:
An old watchman in a poncho guards the lookout gate:
