A porta só abre para quem vencer a Guard.en: The door only opens for those who beat the Sea Guardian.

A porta só abre para quem vencer o Guard.en: The door only opens for those who beat the Forest Guardian.

A porta só abre para quem vencer a Guard.en: The door only opens for those who beat the Sky Guardian.

A porta só abre para quem vencer o Guard.en: The door only opens for those who beat the Earth Guardian. On the other side waits the High Guardian.

A porta da Sala da Memória só se abre pe.en: The Memory Room door only opens by the High Guardian's hand.

• O Conselho dos Guardiões recebe desafi.en: • The Council of Guardians welcomes challengers with sixteen badges. Five battles in a row, no Post in between.

• Aviso dos Guardiões: homens do Cartel.en: • Guardians' notice: Rust Cartel men were seen heading up to the Summit with chains. Be careful.

• Quem perder no Salão é trazido de volt.en: • Anyone who loses in the Hall is brought back to the Gate. Healing here is free.

Tentei o Conselho três vezes. Cheguei à.en: I've tried the Council three times. Reached Jandaia once. Her sky is full of lightning.

Dica de quem caiu muito: compre Elixir e.en: Advice from someone who fell a lot: buy Elixir and Guaraná Tea. In there, every heal is worth a battle.

Meu avô subia esta trilha para levar rec.en: My grandpa used to climb this trail to carry messages from one map to the other. On foot! Nowadays you all come by train and by saveiro.

O Guardião-Mor Arandu é mais velho que e.en: High Guardian Arandu is older than this mountain, they say. Not true. But almost.

Última venda antes do Conselho! Preço de.en: Last shop before the Council! High-altitude prices, but it's what there is: good medicine, good gourds and free pine nuts.

Subi para vender casaco e esqueci o meu..en: I came up here to sell coats and forgot my own. I've been in a T-shirt since Tuesday.

Os Guardiões não usam casaco. Dizem que.en: The Guardians don't wear coats. They say battle keeps you warm.

PICO PINGORAMA — ACAMPAMENTO DA FRONTEIR.en:
PICO PINGORAMA — FRONTIER CAMP

PORTÃO DOS GUARDIÕES\n\"Dezesseis insígn.en:
GUARDIANS' GATE
"Sixteen badges open the gate. A whole team opens the Council."

O CUME\nAdiante, o Salão do Conselho dos.en:
THE SUMMIT
Ahead, the Council of Guardians Hall. Inside: five battles, no way back.

MIRANTE DO CUME\nA oeste, a Costa do Sol.en:
SUMMIT LOOKOUT
To the west, all of Costa do Sol down to the sea. To the east, the Sertão as far as the mist allows.

Um Guardião antigo, de pedra, com o caja.en: An ancient stone Guardian, staff pointed at the summit. On the base: "Who climbs, climbs for all."

A trilha do Monte Tupã desce para a Cost.en:
The Monte Tupã trail goes down to Costa do Sol. Guardian Abaeté, down below, only lets through those who already have fifteen badges.
Without all sixteen, the Peak takes no one to the other side.

A porta de pedra do Salão do Conselho nã.en:
The stone door of the Council Hall won't budge.
Someone from the Cartel chained the bronze rings.

O guardião Tibiriçá, de cocar de penas d.en:
Guardian Tibiriçá, in a headdress of hawk feathers, raises an open hand:
— This is the Guardians' Gate. From here up, only those who beat the sixteen gyms of Pingorama. — There's no shame in turning back. The mountains will wait. When your case is full, the gate opens by itself.

Esta trilha liga a Costa do Sol ao Sertã.en: This trail has linked Costa do Sol to the Sertão since before there were roads. Drovers went up with mules and came down with stories.

Lá no Cume fica o Salão do Conselho. Cin.en: Up on the Summit is the Council Hall. Five Guardians, one after another. Nobody I know got past the second.

Pinhão cozido na fogueira, quentão sem á.en: Pine nuts roasted on the fire, alcohol-free mulled cider and guaraná tea. That's the camp menu.

Os capangas do Cartel subiram ontem com.en: The Cartel goons came up yesterday with crates and chains. Didn't pay for their pine nuts. That I don't forgive.

No Pico o ar é fino. Respire fundo antes.en: On the Peak the air is thin. Breathe deep before each battle and bring medicine in your bag: up there nobody heals you for free.

O Posto daqui é o último antes do Consel.en: This Post is the last one before the Council. If you lose in there, the Guardians bring you to the Gate — and the Post is just below.
